record.question: Which institute has recently announced the creation of the Amartya Sen Chair in Inequality Studies?
options: London School of Economics and Political Science
record.explanation: Answer D: London School of Economics and Political Science. The London School of Economics announced the Amartya Sen Chair in Inequality Studies in March 2019. Reference: https://www.lse.ac.uk/news/latest-news-from-lse/03-mar-19/lse-announces-amartya-sen-chair-in-inequality-studies. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
